 _LOGGING = logging.getLogger(__name__)
+_REACTOR_READY = threading.Event()
+_REACTOR_LOCK = threading.Lock()
+_REACTOR_THREAD: Optional[threading.Thread] = None
+
+
+def _ensure_reactor_running() -> None:
+    global _REACTOR_THREAD
+
+    if reactor.running:
+        _REACTOR_READY.set()
+        return
+
+    with _REACTOR_LOCK:
+        if _REACTOR_THREAD is None or not _REACTOR_THREAD.is_alive():
+            _REACTOR_READY.clear()
+
+            def _run() -> None:
+                reactor.callWhenRunning(_REACTOR_READY.set)
+                reactor.run(installSignalHandlers=False)
+
+            _REACTOR_THREAD = threading.Thread(target=_run, daemon=True)
+            _REACTOR_THREAD.start()
+
+    _REACTOR_READY.wait()
